title: Vintage Le Creuset Cast Iron Dutch Oven No. 20 – Made in France – Enameled Casserole
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset enameled cast iron Dutch oven, size No. 20, made in France. Le Creuset is world-renowned for producing high-quality cast iron cookware known for its durability, excellent heat retention, and timeless design.
This classic casserole features heavy enameled cast iron construction, ensuring even heat distribution and making it perfect for stews, soups, braising, roasting, and slow cooking. The traditional design with two side handles and matching lid makes it both practical and collectible.
Details:
• Brand: Le Creuset
• Type: Cast iron Dutch oven / casserole
• Size: No. 20
• Material: Enameled cast iron
• Made in France
• Two side handles
• Matching lid included
• Classic vintage model
Condition:
Good vintage condition with normal signs of use consistent with age. The enamel interior remains clean and fully functional. Please review photos for full condition details.
A high-quality piece of classic French cookware, ideal for both everyday cooking and collectors of vintage Le Creuset cast iron.
